title: Preserve literal process boundaries across a bounded command batch
prompt:
Release-runner incident: `commandbatch.Run` receives commands that have already been tokenized into an executable path and an argument vector, but the current implementation turns each command back into shell text. Arguments containing spaces, empty strings, dollar signs, semicolons, backslashes, or globs are consequently split, expanded, or executed as syntax. The same implementation also makes the batch result racy and lossy: completion order changes result order, stdout and stderr are merged, every failure becomes exit code 1, and cancellation does not stop a running child.

Repair `batch.go` without changing the public API. Each `Command` must cross the process boundary literally: create the native child directly with `exec.CommandContext`, executing exactly `Path` with `Args` as distinct arguments, with no shell, command string, quoting layer, or reparsing. `Run` must return a non-nil result slice with exactly one entry per input command, in input order. Admit commands from the input in order, run independent commands concurrently, and never have more than `maxParallel` child processes active; treat `maxParallel <= 0` as 1.

Use the supplied context for process execution. Once it is canceled, terminate running children, do not launch commands that have not started, and give every canceled/unstarted entry `ExitCode == -1` with an `Err` matching the context error via `errors.Is`. Capture each child's stdout and stderr separately and attribute both to that command's indexed result, including on failure. A successful exit has code 0 and nil `Err`; a process that exits nonzero retains its exact OS exit code and an error exposing `*exec.ExitError`; a launch failure has code -1 and retains the launch error.

Use only the Go standard library. `batch_test.go` and `nonpositive_limit_test.go` are protected and must not be modified. Verification is offline and deterministic: `env GOCACHE=/tmp/moonshiner-go-commandbatch-build-cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/moonshiner-go-commandbatch-config go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`.

full_distill.primary_skill: execute a bounded concurrent batch through direct per-command argv process boundaries while preserving cancellation and indexed result metadata
full_distill.baseline_evidence: the package builds, but literal metacharacter arguments are reparsed by a shell, result appends race and follow completion order, stderr is merged into stdout, nonzero statuses collapse to 1, and a canceled context neither stops the active child nor produces entries for work waiting on the limit
full_distill.success_contract: native children receive the exact argument vectors; concurrency is both present and capped; cancellation kills active work and suppresses queued launches; every input index has its own ordered stdout, stderr, exact exit code, and retained error
adversarial_factors: the argv fixture includes spaces, an empty argument, a dollar-prefixed literal, a semicolon, a backslash, and a glob so joining plus shell quoting cannot accidentally satisfy the contract
staggered real child processes finish out of order while results must stay indexed by input
a filesystem gate proves two children can overlap at a limit of two while a third cannot start before capacity is released
mid-flight cancellation checks both prompt termination of the active native process and suppression of the next input command
distinct stdout and stderr payloads plus multiple nonzero statuses pin stream ownership and exact OS exit-code preservation
